title: Project title
scope: Effective line-section model. Width is specified by the engineer, not inferred from standards, leg size or penetration.
validation: The mathematical model has not yet been independently validated.
momentNotice: The resultant moment is nonzero. This stored result has no stress distribution; use Calculate to obtain a new result.
snapshot: Saved snapshot opened without recalculation. Press Calculate for a new result. Imported data requires review.
choose: Select a segment or right-click for editor commands.
source: Nominal static model of user-defined effective line elements. Strength is not assessed.
notDesktop: Run the desktop application to calculate and use the project database.
invalidNumber: All fields must contain finite numbers.
safety: Allowables, safety margins and compliance are not determined.
unsavedDescription: Save the current project before continuing?
dragHelp: Drag an endpoint or the whole weld line. Arrows: configured step; Shift: ×10. Alt: bypass snaps; Escape: cancel.
windowError: The window operation could not be completed.
settingsInvalid: Steps must be positive finite numbers; radius must be between 1 and 64 px.
settingsSaveError: Could not save settings. Please try again.
settingsLoadError: Could not load settings. Using defaults.
settingsHelp: Snaps override the movement step. Hold Alt while dragging to bypass snaps. Numeric input is exact. Snaps do not split intersecting welds.
navigationHelp: Wheel: zoom at cursor. Middle mouse button or Pan mode: move the view. Escape cancels the gesture. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo outside text fields.
nominalHelp: Signed global components τx, τy, σz on the XY section. An affine nominal model, without local throat stresses or strength acceptance.
illConditioned: Bending not computed: the section is singular or ill-conditioned. Provide segments spread across the XY plane.
noWelds: Add a weld using the toolbar.
patternHelp: Pieces follow the selected weld from its start. Pitch must exceed length and the last piece must fit. Engineer-supplied dimensions; normative restrictions are not checked.
centreAfterCalculation: C position is available after calculation
loadPointOutside: Application point is outside this view
contourScope: Nominal model. Strength is not assessed.
